how_to_apply: Fill in the Application Proforma (Annexure-A) printed with the advertisement.
Attach a detailed bio-data/CV and the duly filled-in academic performance credentials.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, experience certificates and other supporting documents, with proper page numbering.
Send the complete hard-copy application to the Dean cum Co-Principal Investigator (DST-CoE), College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology, VNMKV, Parbhani-431402.
The application should reach on or before 19-11-2026, during office hours.

content_sections.text: Other conditions: Research Associate must have published at least one paper in SCI or NAAS journals Undertaking on Rs. 100/- stamp paper before joining accepting all terms and conditions Original documents must be produced for verification at the time of interview Desirable: RA: knowledge in designing agricultural machinery and smart agricultural technologies, sensors and instrumentation; NAAS or refereed publications; design/simulation software, AI, ML, image processing, data analytics SRF: design, development, testing of agricultural machinery; UAV-based remote sensing; fabrication and field evaluation; IoT-based equipment, embedded systems, automation JRF: field experiments and data collection; deployment of IoT sensors and precision farming equipment; coordination with farmers; mobile-based advisory and decision-support tools Technical/Project Assistant: GeM, Talley, PFMS accounts, cash book, PPT, Photoshop, Coral draw; typing 30 wpm Marathi and 40 wpm English, MS-CIT; office records; manufacturing machines Skilled Labour: experimental plot work; monitoring office cleaning and record keeping; driving tractor or office four-wheeler vehicles; knowledge of machining/workshop machines Un-skilled Labour: experimental plot work; office cleaning, maintenance and file distribution; should be able to read and write Marathi

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary appointment, terminated after completion of project assignment Maximum 11 months; initial appointment order for 06 months, extension based on satisfactory performance and subject to university approval Must join within seven days of the office order, else the order is cancelled and the waitlisted candidate gets the chance One-month advance written notice to leave, otherwise one month's salary to be deposited No regular leave; CL 08 days a year and university holidays No claim for regular appointment, permanency or seniority in VNMKV

content_sections.heading: How Will VNMKV Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting on merit in 1:5 ratio if more applications are received Academic Performance evaluation (70 marks) Interview / Selection committee marks (30 marks) Academic Performance evaluation by post-wise score card for 70 marks Selection committee marks: 30 marks If more applications are received, shortlisting on merit in 1:5 ratio based on academic performance/publications/experience Only shortlisted eligible candidates will be interviewed by the selection committee

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 1 Research Associate, 2 Senior Research Fellow, 1 Junior Research Fellow, 2 Technical/Project Assistant cum Technician, 1 Contractual Skilled Labour, 1 Contractual Un-skilled Labour.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-A (Application Proforma) in this PDF) and send it to Dean cum Co-Principal Investigator (DST-CoE), College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology, Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth (VNMKV), Parbhani-431402, Maharashtra, by hard copy by post or in person, to reach by 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for men; 45 years for women (as on 12 November 2026). Relaxation: women Age limit 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 58000+ 10%HRA (Fixed Pay) for Research Associate, Rs. 42000+ 10% HRA (Fixed Pay) for Senior Research Fellow, Rs. 37000+ 10% HRA (Fixed Pay) for Junior Research Fellow, Rs. 18000+ 10% HRA (Fixed Pay) for Technical/Project Assistant cum Technician, Rs.15000 (Fixed Pay) for Contractual Skilled Labour.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: RA: Ph.D. (Farm Machinery and Power Engg.) or M.Tech in FMPE with 3 years experience, plus one SCI/NAAS paper; SRF: M.Tech (Agricultural Engineering) with 2 years experience; JRF: Master degree in Agronomy/Soil Science/Genetics and Plant Breeding; Technical/Project Assistant: BCA/BCS/B.Tech CS/B.Tech Mechanical or B.Com; Skilled Labour: HSC (12th) or Diploma in Machinist/Fitter trade; Un-skilled Labour: SSC (10th). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Research Associate must have published at least one paper in SCI or NAAS journals. Undertaking on Rs. 100/- stamp paper before joining accepting all terms and conditions. Original documents must be produced for verification at the time of interview.
